name: Herman Melville
note: Library of ~1,000 volumes at his death; 52 digitally transcribed.

name: Walt Whitman
note: Annotations mostly on loose sheets and clippings, not bound volumes.

name: Gabriel Harvey
note: Spenser's correspondent; the most prolific annotator in AOR.

name: John Dee
note: Not a literary author -- included because AOR is the reference implementation of a marginalia data model, and Dee is half of it.

name: John Winthrop
note: Three pages in AOR's Paracelsus_Meteorum only.

name: Jacques Derrida
note: Library of ~13,800 volumes at PUL; this dataset is phase 1 only, the books behind De la grammatologie (1967).
